sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Let's say you lived sometime before 1860 and you wanted to fire a rifle.
sentences.zh: 假设你生活在1860年之前，而你想开枪射击一支步枪。

sentences.en: First, you'd need to pour gunpowder into the powder charge to measure the amount of gunpowder you needed.
sentences.zh: 首先，你需要把火药倒进火药池里，以量出你所需的火药量。

sentences.en: And then you'd pack down your gunpowder and then bullet into the rifle with a ramrod.
sentences.zh: 然后，你要用通条把火药和子弹一起塞进枪管里。

sentences.en: Then you'd pull back the hammer and take something called a percussion cap and you'd fit it on the hollow metal nipple on the back of the barrel.
sentences.zh: 接着，你得拉回击锤，拿一个叫作火帽的东西，把它安在枪管后方的中空金属乳头上。

sentences.en: So, pull the trigger and that was one shot.
sentences.zh: 然后，扣动扳机，这就开了一枪。

sentences.en: Then you had to reload, which meant pouring out new gunpowder, stuffing the gunpowder and the new bullet down with a ramrod,
sentences.zh: 接下来你必须重新装填，这意味着要倒出新火药，用通条把火药和新子弹塞下去，

sentences.en: pulling back the hammer, putting a new percussion cap on the nipple, and then you could shoot again.
sentences.zh: 拉回击锤，在乳头上装一个新的火帽，然后你才能再次开枪。

sentences.en: The whole process took at least as long as it just took for me to describe it.
sentences.zh: 整个过程花费的时间至少和我刚才描述它的时间一样长。

sentences.en: And as you can imagine, this was all really inconvenient if someone was shooting at you.
sentences.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，如果有人在向你开枪，这一切就会变得非常不便。

sentences.en: But then came the Winchester Repeater Rifle.
sentences.zh: 但随后，温彻斯特连发步枪问世了。

sentences.en: That's reporter Nina Gensler-Debs.
sentences.zh: 那是记者妮娜·根斯勒-德布斯。

sentences.en: The Winchester 1866 Repeater Rifle was a thing of beauty.
sentences.zh: 温彻斯特1866年型连发步枪堪称一件艺术品。

sentences.en: Nicknamed the Yellow Boy for its bright brass receiver, the gun was sleek, gleaming, and deadly.
sentences.zh: 这把枪因其明亮的黄铜机匣而被昵称为“黄男孩”，它线条流畅、闪闪发光且极其致命。

sentences.en: You could fire off 15 shots in just over 10 seconds.
sentences.zh: 你可以在短短10秒多一点的时间里连开15枪。

sentences.en: And the Winchester Repeater arrived on the market just in time for the rise of Western expansion.
sentences.zh: 而温彻斯特连发步枪进入市场的时间，恰逢西方扩张的兴起。

sentences.en: The huge sweep of manifest destiny and people migrating to the western part of North America.
sentences.zh: 那是昭昭天命的浩大浪潮，人们纷纷向北美洲西部迁移。

sentences.en: That weapon became a source of survival and protection for people.
sentences.zh: 那把武器成了人们生存和保护的源泉。

sentences.en: The next iteration of the Winchester Repeater, the 1873 model, was an even bigger hit.
sentences.zh: 温彻斯特连发步枪的下一代型号——1873年型，取得了更大的成功。

sentences.zh: 但大概只有那些自认为赢得了西部的人才会这么觉得。

sentences.zh: 五年后，莎拉挚爱的丈夫威廉因结核病去世。

sentences.zh: 他年仅43岁。

sentences.en: After losing her husband, Sarah Winchester then lost her father-in-law and her eldest sister.
sentences.zh: 失去丈夫后，莎拉·温彻斯特又失去了公公和长姐。

sentences.en: Sarah was now alone.

sentences.zh: 如果莎拉要平息他们的怨魂，她就必须建造一座非常非常大的房子。

sentences.zh: 她在圣何塞买下一栋八个房间的农舍，一头扎进了改建工程中。

sentences.zh: 莎拉·温彻斯特的施工队以轮班制夜以继日地在房子里干了38年。

sentences.zh: 你知道的，它有一种闹鬼豪宅的特质。

sentences.en: But for a long time, no one was able to see the hodgepodge of styles and ornaments in this house except Sarah Winchester.

sentences.zh: 因为莎拉·温彻斯特深居简出。

sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚关于莎拉·温彻斯特的传说有多少是真的。

sentences.zh: 我们不知道她是否真的与幽灵交流过，或者至少认为自己在与幽灵交流，

sentences.zh: 房间一直在被调整和改造。

sentences.en: Rooms were constantly being tweaked and remodeled.
sentences.zh: 此外，1906年的地震产生了重大影响。

sentences.en: Plus, the 1906 earthquake had a major effect.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有房子的原始蓝图，但我们确实知道地震摧毁了豪宅的正门以及第三层和第四层。

sentences.en: There are no original blueprints for the house, but we do know that the earthquake destroyed the front of the mansion and the third and fourth stories.
sentences.zh: 她觉得房子的缺陷在1906年的地震中真正显露出来了。

sentences.en: She felt like the defects of the house really came to the fore in the 1906 earthquake.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于发生这种事，她对自己建造的工艺感到有些懊恼。

sentences.en: And so she kind of was chagrined at her own workmanship that this would happen.
sentences.zh: 莎拉没有选择重建，而是让工人们清理瓦砾，使这个地方安全，然后直接把房子的正面用木板封了起来。

sentences.en: Instead of rebuilding, Sarah had workers clear away the rubble and make the place safe and then just boarded up the front of the house.
sentences.zh: 所以很有可能，楼梯通向的是一个在地震中被毁的房间。

sentences.en: So it's very possible that the stairs led to a room that got destroyed in the quake.
sentences.zh: 至于所有那些数字13，玛丽·约并不太在意。

sentences.en: As for all those 13s, Mary Jo doesn't put a lot of stock in them.
sentences.zh: 她相信其中一些可能并非出自莎拉·温彻斯特之手。

sentences.en: And she believes that some of them might not be from Sarah Winchester.
sentences.zh: 几位曾在该房屋工作的工人在20世纪20年代表示，那些对数字13的引用是在她死后才添加的。

sentences.en: A couple of the men who worked on the house, they stated in the 1920s that those references to the number 13 were added after her death.
sentences.zh: 至于莎拉·温彻斯特是否在她所谓的降神室里进行过降神会，这是有可能的。

sentences.en: As to whether Sarah Winchester conducted seances in her supposed seance room, it's possible.
sentences.zh: 这是有可能的。

sentences.en: Spiritualism and seances were actually fairly common practice in Sarah Winchester's time.
sentences.zh: 在莎拉·温彻斯特的时代，唯灵论和降神会实际上是非常普遍的做法。

sentences.en: But still, Mary Jo finds it unlikely, partly because of the location of the room in the middle of the house.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽·乔仍然认为这种说法不太可能，部分原因在于那个房间位于房子的正中央。

sentences.en: Anybody who knows about spiritualism or seances know that those are really public affairs, social affairs at the very least, if not public.
sentences.zh: 任何了解唯灵论或降神会的人都知道，这些活动本质上是非常公开的事情，至少也是社交活动，如果说不上是公众活动的话。

sentences.en: And you would have that in your front parlor.
sentences.zh: 而且你应该会在前客厅里举行这种活动。

sentences.en: Then again, Sarah was a very private person, so maybe she did her seances alone.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，莎拉是一个非常注重隐私的人，所以也许她是独自一人进行降神会的。

sentences.en: The ranch foreman also stated that he had actually stayed in that room and it was not related to any kind of spiritual or superstitious events at all.
sentences.zh: 牧场工头也表示，他实际上在那间房里住过，这与任何灵异或迷信事件完全没有关系。

sentences.en: And lastly, in the popular legend about Sarah Winchester, her whole building endeavor was set in motion after seeing a medium by the name of Adam Coombs,
sentences.zh: 最后，在关于莎拉·温彻斯特的流行传说中，她整个建造工程的起因是拜访了一位名叫亚当·库姆斯的灵媒，

sentences.en: who had supposedly put her in touch with her dead husband.
sentences.zh: 据说正是这位灵媒让她与死去的丈夫取得了联系。

sentences.en: But Mary Jo gained access to a list of mediums and spiritualists that would have been practicing in New England during Sarah Winchester's lifetime.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽·乔获取了一份在莎拉·温彻斯特有生之年在新英格兰执业的灵媒和唯灵论者名单。
zh_words: 莎拉·温彻斯特有生之年

sentences.en: The name that's usually associated with having seen Winchester is not there.
sentences.zh: 那个通常与温彻斯特相联系的名字并不在上面。

sentences.en: Adam Coombs may never have existed at all.
sentences.zh: 亚当·库姆斯可能根本就不存在。

sentences.en: There are some things we'll never know about Sarah Winchester.
sentences.zh: 关于莎拉·温彻斯特，有些事情我们永远不会知道。

sentences.en: But what Mary Jo does feel like we can know for sure is that Sarah wasn't out of touch with reality.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽·乔确信我们能知道的是，莎拉并没有与现实脱节。

sentences.en: On the contrary, she was rational and savvy.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，她很理智而且精明。

sentences.en: This is a woman so far ahead of her time in financial matters, in her real estate investment, in her bond portfolio.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在财务问题、房地产投资和债券组合方面远远领先于时代女性。

sentences.en: It's remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真了不起。

sentences.en: It's really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真的很了不起。

sentences.en: So why does a financially savvy, forward-thinking woman build such a crazy, never-ending house?
sentences.zh: 那么，一个精通财务、富有前瞻性的女性为什么要建造这样一座疯狂的、永远建造不完的房子呢？

sentences.en: Mary Jo has a different theory.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·乔有另一种理论。

sentences.en: No ghosts involved.
sentences.zh: 与鬼魂无关。

sentences.en: She was an architect wannabe.
sentences.zh: 她是一个有志于成为建筑师的人。

sentences.en: Sarah Winchester wanted to be an architect.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·温彻斯特想成为一名建筑师。

sentences.en: She loved doing, building, experimenting.
sentences.zh: 她热爱动手、建造和实验。

sentences.en: And I love that theory.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个理论。

sentences.en: Sarah Winchester lived at a time when...
sentences.zh: 莎拉·温彻斯特生活的时代……

sentences.en: It was highly unusual to have women architects.
sentences.zh: 拥有女建筑师是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: And she wasn't licensed.
sentences.zh: 而且她没有取得执照。

sentences.en: So her own house was the perfect place, the only place really, for her to practice architecture.
sentences.zh: 所以她自己的房子是完美的场所，实际上也是唯一能让她实践建筑学的场所。

sentences.en: And it became her playground.
sentences.zh: 这里成了她的游乐场。

sentences.en: Sometimes in the middle of a project, she'd lose interest and move on to something else.
sentences.zh: 有时在一个项目进行到一半时，她会失去兴趣并转向其他事情。

sentences.en: From all this emerged an odd and frenetic confluence of architecture.
sentences.zh: 所有这些汇聚成了一种奇特而狂热的建筑风格交融。

sentences.en: But her house isn't only a collection of oddities.
sentences.zh: 但她的房子不只是奇特事物的集合。

sentences.en: There are some legitimately innovative elements, too.
sentences.zh: 其中也有一些合乎情理的创新元素。

sentences.en: There's a solarium with a zinc floor.
sentences.zh: 有一个带锌地板的日光浴室。

sentences.en: It doesn't rest, and it's tilted for the water to run off and be used in the garden.
sentences.zh: 它不会生锈，而且带有倾斜度，以便水流走并用于花园。

sentences.en: There are also these amazing, zig-zagging stairs that, instead of going up at a steep pitch, rise in shallower increments.
sentences.zh: 还有这些令人惊叹的之字形楼梯，它们没有采用陡峭的坡度上升，而是以较小的台阶高度上升。

sentences.en: Sarah Winchester had debilitating arthritis, and these stairs made it possible for her to move about her house.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·温彻斯特患有严重的关节炎，这些楼梯使她能够在屋里四处走动。

sentences.en: The legend says that Sarah and her crew worked on her house 24 hours a day for 38 years.
sentences.zh: 传说莎拉和她的工人们连续38年每天24小时在她的房子里劳作。

sentences.en: And that, upon hearing of her death, her work crew finally set down their hammers and walked off the job.
sentences.zh: 并且据说在听到她去世的消息后，她的工人们终于放下锤子，离开了工作岗位。

sentences.en: This is most likely an exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是一种夸张。

sentences.en: But the house was certainly a project that consumed Mrs. Winchester's attention for decades.
sentences.zh: 但这座房子确实是一个耗费了温彻斯特夫人几十年精力的项目。

sentences.en: Finally, he told her that by doing what he had prescribed, she would gain immortality.
sentences.zh: 最后，他告诉她，只要照他说的做，她就能获得永生。

sentences.en: And of course, she didn't gain immortality from all of her building, as the spirits had supposedly promised.
sentences.zh: 当然，正如那些幽灵曾经承诺的那样，她并没有通过所有的建造获得永生。

sentences.en: But she did live into her 80s.
sentences.zh: 但她确实活到了八十多岁。

sentences.en: In the end, whatever her motivations were, Sarah Winchester built a house with over 150 rooms,
sentences.zh: 总之，无论她的动机是什么，莎拉·温彻斯特建造了一座拥有150多个房间的房子，

sentences.en: 2,000 doors, 47 fireplaces, 40 bedrooms, 40 staircases, 17 chimneys, 13 bathrooms, 6 kitchens, 3 elevators, 2 basements, and 1 shower.
sentences.zh: 2000扇门，47个壁炉，40间卧室，40处楼梯，17个烟囱，13间浴室，6间厨房，3部电梯，2个地下室和1间淋浴间。

sentences.en: And spent nearly all of her life being an architect.
sentences.zh: 并且几乎将她一生的大部分时间都用来当建筑师。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Nina Gensler-Dabbs, with Avery Truffleman, Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由妮娜·根斯勒-达布斯制作，合作者包括艾弗里·特拉夫曼、凯蒂·明格、萨姆·格林斯潘以及我，罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7, local public radio KALW in San Francisco, and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 地方公共广播电台 KALW 的一个项目，制作办公室位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽的市中心，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 那是一家名为 ArcSign 的建筑与室内设计公司。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, Tumblr, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我们在 Twitter、Tumblr、Instagram 和 Spotify 上都有账号。

sentences.en: And you can listen to every single episode of 99% Invisible at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 99pi.org 上收听《99%隐形》的每一期节目。
